answer: Require stake-bonded identity at the marketplace inlet: an agent trades only after locking a refundable deposit tied to one verifiable work history, and misbehavior slashes the deposit and revokes that history. Like a reef, reputation grows slowly from real completed work, not cheaply spawned names. An attacker wanting a thousand fake voices must fund a thousand deposits and build a thousand histories, while an honest agent needs one; across a broad mesa of participants, that per-identity cost makes large Sybil attacks unprofitable.
